response.description_short: Fivetran is an automated data integration company that builds pipelines moving data into cloud warehouses for analytics teams.
response.description_long: Fivetran is an automated data integration company. It builds automated data integration pipelines that move data into cloud warehouses for analytics teams. The company maintains a catalog of connectors, which it has expanded to support data integration between sources and cloud warehouses. Its products are aimed at analytics teams that need data moved into cloud warehouses.
